quotes.name: Marin Tao
quotes.quote: Honestly, I don't think about it that much. I'm just doing my thing, playing music, and trying to make a living. If people are talking about me, that's cool, but it's not something I focus on. I'm just trying to be true to myself and my art.

quotes.name: Dax Monroe
quotes.quote: Honestly, I haven't really thought about Marin Tao's rising fame and how it affects Oakland's cultural scene. I'm just trying to focus on my own art and life in Rockridge. I do know that there's been a lot of talk about the city's cultural scene lately, but I don't really feel like I'm in the loop.

quotes.name: Rico Valez
quotes.quote: Honestly, I've been feeling like there's a lot of energy around Oakland's cultural scene lately, and I think Marin Tao's rising fame is a part of that. As a musician, I can feel the vibe of the city, and it seems like people are excited about what's happening here. I'm not sure what the future holds, but it's cool to see Oakland getting attention.

quotes.name: Dank Abara
quotes.quote: I've noticed that Marin Tao's rising fame seems to be getting a lot of attention in Oakland, and as a waiter, I've heard people talking about it around San Antonio.
